title: warm croatian pepper gratin
description: a hearty yeasty croatian dish featuring roasted pepper, yuzu-cure and jain-friendly ingredients
instructions: slice the bell peppers into 1/2-inch thick rounds and place them on a baking sheet.
sprinkle the shallots and garlic over the bell peppers, and drizzle with 2 tbsp of the vegetarian butter.
roast the peppers in the preheated oven for 20-25 minutes, or until the skin is blistered and charred.
remove the peppers from the oven and let them cool slightly.
in a large saucepan, combine the yeast, gluten-free flour, beef broth, water, salt, and black pepper.
bring the mixture to a simmer over medium heat, whisking constantly.
reduce the heat to low and cook for 5-7 minutes, or until the mixture has thickened.
add the yuzu-cured olives, chopped fresh dill, and parmesan cheese to the saucepan, and stir to combine.
place the roasted peppers in a 9x13-inch baking dish and spoon the sauce over the top.
dot the top of the peppers with the remaining 2 tbsp of vegetarian butter.
cover the dish with aluminum foil and bake for 20-25 minutes, or until the peppers are tender and the sauce is bubbly.
remove the foil and continue baking for an additional 5-10 minutes, or until the top is golden brown.
serve the warm croatian pepper gratin hot, garnished with additional chopped fresh dill if desired.
